records.Title: SMP – Mechanical inspection
records.Procedure / Guidance: Isolation/LOTO → guards/coupling → bearing temperature/vibration → lubrication → alignment/fastening → trial run → record.

records.Title: SMP – Gearbox inspection
records.Procedure / Guidance: Isolation → oil level/leakage/condition → breather → temperature/vibration → lubrication nozzles → abnormal noise → record.

records.Title: SMP – Hydraulic inspection
records.Procedure / Guidance: Isolation → oil level/temp → pressure → leakage → filters → pumps → accumulator → valves/cylinders → record.

records.Title: SMP – Walking beam inspection
records.Procedure / Guidance: Approved shutdown/isolation → wheels/guides/sprockets/pulleys → clearances → lubrication → structure → approved functional test.

records.Title: SMP – ECS pump inspection
records.Procedure / Guidance: Standby readiness → vibration/temp → seal → bearing → coupling/alignment → suction/discharge → flow/pressure → record.
